statement: Before Wii joystick open, SDL's device initialization reads the extension identity. If that identity denotes an active MotionPlus mapping, ReadExtensionControllerType resets extension registers and then requests the prior MotionPlus mode again. On Linux the restoration call omits the write and cached-mode assignment. Thus a MotionPlus evdev holder opened before SDL may still race with SDL's reset/kernel reconciliation; record A400F0 and A600FE writes with actor attribution rather than assuming the mapped state persists.

applicability.revision: SDL 3.2.10, SDL 3.4.18 and SDL main at pinned October 2026 source commits; no retail Wii measurement
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. SendExtensionReset 370-382; ReadExtensionControllerType 677-709; HIDAPI_DriverWii_InitDevice 735-752; ActivateMotionPlusWithMode 457-468. Source-level race candidate only.
